title: I Generated 100 AI Animations in Unity — Fully Local! | Kimonuty Motion Lab
author: AyzyUlany
selftext:
I just released Kimonuty, a local text-to-animation tool for Unity.

It uses the C++/GGML port of Kimodo through a native Unity plugin. The text encoder loads in configurable chunks to manage VRAM usage, and there’s a CPU mode too. No separate Python or CUDA setup needed.

For this video, I generated 100 humanoid animations on an RTX 4070 with 12 GB VRAM. The whole run took about 3 hours and 21 minutes, condensed into a timelapse with all the animations playing together at the end.

[Unity Asset Store](https://assetstore.unity.com/packages/tools/animation/kimonuty-motion-lab-410834)
